note: open-notebook: FastAPI API + background worker (uv) + Next.js frontend (standalone build), with SurrealDB v2 in the official container (in-memory for tests). Started as its supervisord does (start.sh); the browser only talks to the Next.js server, which forwards /api to the API on 5055.
setup: cd frontend && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx next build
cd frontend && S=$(dirname $(find .next/standalone -name server.js -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head -1)) && mkdir -p $S/.next && cp -r .next/static $S/.next/ && cp -r public $S/
